subject: Qualico vendor enrollment: PO mapping, ledger token & tax evidence
messages:
From: John Marlow <john.marlow@qualico.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@qualico.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood deployment

Hi Kimberly,

We're getting Redwood set up in our procurement system for a pilot deployment. Our AP team needs the vendor enrollment packet and a short list of the PO fields you require for automated matching. Specifically:
- Required PO fields (PO number, billing entity name, remit address)
- Any special invoice metadata (model id, deployment id, usage period)
- Preferred remit format (EFT/ACH, bank details/format)
- VAT / tax evidence needed for US / EU entities

I attached a sample PO we received from another vendor to show our format. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept PO numbers in the reference/purchaseOrderId field and whether we should include deployment metadata on the invoice header or a line-item note?

Thanks,
John Marlow
Procurement Lead — Qualico Inc
[Attachment: Qualico_PO_Sample_2025-05.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: John Marlow <john.marlow@qualico.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood deployment

Hi John — thanks for the note and the sample PO.

Short answer: yes, we can map the PO number to purchaseOrderId and include deployment metadata. I'll outline our standard AP onboarding requirements below and attach our packet.

AP packet (attached) includes:
- Supplier legal name and remittance ledger token (we can supply token after vendor record created)
- Bank remit instructions: ACH (preferred) with bank name, account, routing; or SWIFT for international
- Invoice requirements: invoice number, invoice date, purchaseOrderId (exact match), line-item description, quantity, unit price, tax amount
- Optional metadata we recommend: model_name / model_version, deployment_id (helps routing), billing_period_start/end
- Tax evidence: W-9 for US entities; EU customers: if reverse-charge applies, we ask for VAT registration and invoice VAT fields

A few operational notes:
- For automated PO matching we require the PO number to be present on header purchaseOrderId or invoice reference. If you want deployment metadata embedded, header metadata is fine as long as it's machine-parsable (key:value).
- If Qualico enforces multiple remit accounts per BU, we can register multiple ledger tokens and return the correct token in our remittance stub.

I've attached our AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf. Could you return the completed packet plus a sample of the PO you plan to send in production? Once we receive the completed packet we can create the vendor record and generate a ledger token for you to use in PO mapping.

Looping in Laura from Finance to confirm ledger token workflow.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: AP_Onboarding_Packet_v2.pdf (pdf)]

From: John Marlow <john.marlow@qualico.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: accounts@qualico.com
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 14:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood deployment

Kimberly — good, thanks. Attached is a filled sample with how our system will surface the PO. Two quick clarifications:
1) Tax/VAT: Qualico is US-headquartered but has an Irish subsidiary handling EMEA purchases. For EMEA POs we will include the subsidiary VAT ID in the PO header and expect Redwood invoices to reflect VAT treatment.
2) Remit: We will prefer ACH domestically and SWIFT for Ireland. Are you able to accept change-of-remit requests per purchase order dynamically?

I'll also attach a signed W-9 from our side if you need it.

Thanks,
John
[Attachments: Qualico_PO_Sample_Filled.pdf, W9_Qualico.pdf]

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 08:11:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood deployment

Thanks for the context. Quick internal notes for record: 
- Once the completed AP packet and W-9 arrive we will create vendor record in NetPay and generate the ledger token. Estimated lead time 2 business days.
- We support multiple remit destinations per vendor; we will associate remit routing to a ledger token and expose token->remit mapping in the onboarding summary.
- For EU/Irish VAT handling: Finance will mark the vendor entity as "EU subsidiary" and tag invoices that contain VAT to route through the EU ledger (separate remit if required). Need the Irish VAT ID and the billing legal entity for that set of POs.

Action items for Kimberly: please request the customer provide the Irish VAT ID and indicate which invoices will be billed to the Irish subsidiary (EMEA) vs US HQ. Also confirm whether Qualico will be sending PO-level remit overrides (we can accept per-PO remit, documented on the PO header as remit_token or remit_account_number).

I'll prepare the vendor record template and the ledger token issuance checklist and drop into the Drive link.

- Laura
Director, Finance Operations — Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: John Marlow <john.marlow@qualico.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, aditya_rao@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor registration & PO requirements for Redwood deployment

John — great, thanks for the filled sample and the W-9. Two quick next steps so we can proceed:

1) Can you confirm the Irish VAT ID and the legal billing name for the Irish entity (exact spelling)? We need that to create the EU vendor profile.

2) Please confirm whether Qualico will send remit override on the PO header as remit_token (preferred) or raw bank account details. If you choose remit_token we will tie that token to the correct EU/US remit mapping and the PO will route automatically.

3) I'll send a short Doc with the ledger token lifecycle and a one-page mapping table. Expect the vendor record to be live within 48 hours of receiving the completed packet + VAT ID.

If it's helpful, here's a suggested PO header mapping your procurement team can use:
- purchaseOrderId: PO number (required)
- billingLegalName: vendor legal name (required for EU)
- remit_token: optional (preferred for per-PO remit)
- deployment_id: optional (recommended)

I'll attach the signed W-9 to the vendor record after we receive your confirmation.

Next call if needed? Happy to do a 20-minute sync with your AP ops to run through examples.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: vendor-record-template.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
